text:
noah: Heads up — CI on main is red: integ-tests -> redis-auth-suite timing out (job 8422). Failing on the mock auth handshake. Anyone else seeing this?
ci-bot: build 8422 failed: integ-tests/redis-auth-suite — timeout after 10m (step: run-integration). Logs: https://ci.internal/r/8422
maria: looking... grabbing logs now, will paste snippet if anything obvious.
raj: saw a similar spike earlier today in a separate branch. Could be mock-redis-auth container not coming up (healthcheck failing) due to port reuse.
tara: i just retried job 8422 -> rerun#1 and it failed in ~8m with same timeout.
noah: can someone paste the container logs? especially the mock-auth service.
maria: logs from mock-redis-auth container (tail):
```
2026-03-16T14:12:03.123Z ERROR bind EADDRINUSE 0.0.0.0:6379
2026-03-16T14:12:03.124Z WARN healthcheck failed: /health -> 504
2026-03-16T14:12:03.125Z INFO exiting with code 1
```
raj: EADDRINUSE fits — CI runner is sometimes leaving orphaned docker networks/containers around. When that happens the new container can't bind 6379 and healthcheck never passes.
devops: confirmed there were leftover containers on that runner from an earlier job (cleanup failed). I cleared them and started a manual run locally on the runner -> mock came up fine.
noah: ok — so root cause likely leftover containers on the autoscaling CI runnner. For now, what's the mitigation?
tara: quick mitigation: add a flaky skip for the redis-auth-suite on main for next few deploys, then revert once runner cleanup is fixed. I can open the PR.
maria: or make the mock pick a random port if 6379 is taken and write the port to env for tests. That would be safer but requires more change.
raj: short-term skip + issue to harden mock + runner cleanup fix sounds good. Can we also bisect to see when it started?
noah: please bisect to the last green -> next failing and paste the range. @raj can you do that?
raj: running `git bisect` locally against the integration matrix — will update in thread.
devops: created incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CI-1257 — title: "CI runner leftover containers causing mock-redis bind failures". Assigning to eng-infra.
sre-bot: tagging oncall: @oncall-eng-infra — this affects CI reliability.
maria: opened quick PR to skip the flaky test on main: https://git.internal/p/1234 (WIP) — will mark as temporary and link the ticket.
noah: thanks. action items: (1) eng-infra: fix runner cleanup (CI-1257), (2) eng-runtime/devs: short-term test skip (PR 1234), (3) eng-ml: consider port-randomization/healthcheck hardening for mock.
raj: bisect update: suspected bad range 6 commits; narrowing now. will post commit that introduced the first failure.
tara: rerun after cleanup succeeded (rerun#2) — green. so flaky but reproducible when runner had leftovers.
maria: leaving a note in the repo README about adding a CI healthcheck for mock containers.
noah: great. i'll close the loop when CI-1257 has a fix deployed. For now, thumbs-up on the short-term skip. :thumbsup:
raj: :eyes:
ci-bot: job 8422 rerun#3 -> success
noah: closing thread once PR merges and ticket is tracked. Thanks all. :sparkles:
